name: second-brain
description: Vault-path-agnostic port of the claude-skills second-brain skills. Vault path resolves from the SECOND_BRAIN_VAULT_PATH env var or secondBrain.vaultPath in ~/.claude/settings.json — never hardcoded. Provides capture (quick-append a note to the vault inbox) and query (search the vault for notes on a topic). sync stays in claude-skills for now.
